title: Observability Model
description: Schema for the bank's observability architecture: telemetry pipeline, per-service instrumentation standards, log schemas, data freshness contracts, and design decisions.

log_routing_architecture.description: Defines the telemetry pipeline from emission through collection to fan-out, plus the four separate stores.

description.description: High-level narrative of the log routing architecture and its key principles.

pipeline.description: Ordered stages of the telemetry pipeline from service emission to backend fan-out.

component.description: Named component responsible for this stage, if applicable.

transforms.description: Transformations applied at this stage (e.g. PII scrubbing).

destinations.description: Named destinations that receive data at this stage.

stores.description: The four telemetry stores, each with distinct retention, access, and purpose.

technology.description: Technology stack or product used for this store.

retention.description: Data retention period or policy for this store.

access.description: Who is permitted to query this store.

purpose.description: What data this store holds and why.

per_service_instrumentation_checklist.description: Mandatory and recommended instrumentation items every service must implement.

id.description: Unique checklist item identifier in the format OBS-XXX.

name.description: Short name of the instrumentation requirement.

description.description: Full specification of what must be implemented and any hard constraints.

mandatory.description: When true, absence of this instrumentation causes service startup failure.

logging_schema_by_category.description: Per-category log field extensions beyond the base schema, with critical rules for each service class.

category.description: Name of the service category this schema extension applies to.

services.description: List of services that belong to this category.

extension_fields.description: Fields added to the base log schema for this category. Array notation (e.g. downstream_calls[]) indicates a repeated field.

critical_rules.description: Non-negotiable rules for this category, including PII prohibitions, compliance requirements, and security-critical behaviours.

data_freshness.description: Freshness contracts for each data type surfaced by the Observability Aggregator, with banking relevance rationale.

data_type.description: The category of data subject to this freshness contract.

freshness.description: Maximum acceptable staleness of this data type when surfaced to consumers.

model.description: Mechanism by which the aggregator receives updates: push (webhook) or pull (poll).

banking_relevance.description: Why this freshness contract matters in the context of banking regulation, SLAs, or operational risk.

design_decisions.description: Architectural decisions that shaped the observability model, with rationale for future maintainers.

id.description: Unique decision identifier in the format DD-OBS-XXX.

decision.description: The decision taken, stated as a present-tense directive.

rationale.description: Why this decision was made — the forces and trade-offs considered.

alternatives_considered.description: Alternative approaches that were evaluated and not chosen.

rejected_because.description: Consolidated reason why the alternatives were rejected.
